name: Search API Sorts
description: Create sort options for search queries executed via the Search API.
project_description:
Provides custom sorts and a global sort block for Search API .

 Compatibility 
 This module is compatible with Search API , Search API ranges (slider) , Search API Solr and Search API ajax . Is not tested with Apache Solr Integration module.

 Features 
 
 Choose which fields to sort by. 
 Choose default sort. 
 Choose default order. 
 
 Drupal 8 
 NOTE: For the D8 version search_api 8.x-1.16 or higher is required

 New in D8: You can now configure sorts for each "search api display" (e.g. each views page using the index), where the d7 version only allows configuring on a global "search api index"-base.
